alt: 年輕跑者滿頭汗水奮力爬坡，朝前方同伴追趕，旁邊攤開記錄跑姿的練習本。
scene_prompt: A diligent young runner trains up a grassy hillside at dawn, leaning forward with effort, sweat and determined face, passing a simple practice cone. In foreground a small open training notebook shows only three sequential drawings of improving running posture, no words or numerals. Other runners continue up the hill ahead; the main runner clearly strives to improve, no river.
